summary: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment.
whenToUse: Plan enterprise Azure infrastructure from a workload or architecture description
Architect a landing zone, hub-spoke network, or multi-region topology
Design networking infrastructure: VNets, subnets, firewalls, private endpoints, VPN gateways
Plan identity, RBAC, and compliance-driven infrastructure
Generate Bicep or Terraform for subscription-scope or multi-resource-group deployments
Plan disaster recovery, failover, or cross-region high-availability topologies
verification: Run az bicep build --file infra/main.bicep to validate syntax before deploying.
